verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll and EOR platform, so offering a 401(k) or retirement plan with contributions synced to each payroll is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions retirement plans, 401(k), pensions or benefits contribution syncing. Generic payroll-input sync and webhooks are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll
